files.content:
name: KitGUI
version: 1.0
main: pl.dawio.kitgui.Main
api-version: '1.21'
commands:
  kit:
    description: Otwiera menu wyboru kitów
    usage: /<command>
    permission: kitgui.use
    permission-message: Nie masz uprawnień do użycia tego polecenia.
permissions:
  kitgui.use:
    description: Pozwala używać komendy /kit
    default: true
  kitgui.kit.*:
    description: Pozwala otrzymać dany kit
    default: op

kits:
  starter:
    display-name: "Starter Kit"
    items:
      - "minecraft:iron_sword{Enchantments:[{id:"minecraft:sharpness",lvl:1}]};1"
      - "minecraft:bread;16"
  builder:
    display-name: "Builder Kit"
    items:
      - "minecraft:oak_planks;64"
      - "minecraft:stone;64"
  archer:
    display-name: "Archer Kit"
    items:
      - "minecraft:bow{Enchantments:[{id:"minecraft:power",lvl:2}]};1"
      - "minecraft:arrow;32"
